title: Your next cloud storage payment can be your last — get lifetime access to 100TB for $974.97
content_html:
TL;DR: New users can get 100TB of encrypted Internxt Drive storage for life for $974.97 (reg. $9,900) during the September Flash Sale.

Credit: Internxt

$974.97
$9,900 Save $8,925.03

Tired of constantly running out of cloud storage? Every time you need more space, the monthly fees climb higher, keeping you in an expensive, never-ending cycle of upgrades and charges. As we accumulate more data every day, it may be time to consider a more financially responsible approach to keeping your files safe.

With Internxt Cloud Storage, you truly own your space — there’s no more renting your data storage. And right now, you can lock in an ample 100TB of storage for just $974.97 (reg. $9,900).

Using iCloud to keep your files safe? The maximum storage Apple allows you to rent is currently just 12TB — and it costs $64.99 a month. If you’re looking for a more affordable way to safeguard your precious data, providing enough space to last a lifetime, it’s time to check out Internxt Cloud Storage.

With Internxt Cloud Storage, you own your storage space. That means you can say goodbye to those hefty monthly fees and rest easy knowing you can keep all your important data in one secure space. You can also rest easy knowing Internxt’s end-to-end encryption is so secure that even the company itself can’t access your data.

It’s also GDPR compliant — adhering to strict European privacy laws — and audited and verified by Securitum. That’s a major improvement over other cloud storage services, which not only access your data but also make money from it through targeted ads and data sharing.

If you’re making the switch, Internxt offers cross-platform compatibility so you can easily integrate it across all your devices and operating systems via a desktop app, web browser app, and iOS or Android app.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Never pay for cloud storage again with this 100TB Internxt Cloud Storage lifetime subscription for just $974.97 (reg. $9,900) through during this September Flash Sale.

StackSocial prices subject to change.

图片来源：Internxt

$974.97
$9,900 Save $8,925.03

厌倦了不断耗尽云存储空间？ 每当您需要更多空间时，每月的费用就会上涨，使您陷入昂贵且永无休止的升级和收费循环中。 随着我们每天积累更多的数据，可能是时候考虑采取一种对经济更负责任的方法来保护您的文件安全了。

借助 Internxt 云存储，您真正拥有自己的空间 - 无需再租用数据存储。 And right now, you can lock in an ample 100TB of storage for just $974.97 (reg. $9,900).

使用 iCloud 来保证文件安全？ 目前，Apple 允许您租用的最大存储空间仅为 12TB，每月费用为 64.99 美元。 如果您正在寻找一种更实惠的方式来保护您的宝贵数据，并提供足够的空间供您终生使用，那么是时候考虑一​​下 Internxt 云存储了。

借助 Internxt Cloud Storage，您拥有自己的存储空间。 这意味着您可以告别高昂的月费，高枕无忧，因为您可以将所有重要数据保存在一个安全的空间中。 您还可以放心，Internxt 的端到端加密非常安全，即使是公司本身也无法访问您的数据。

它还符合 GDPR（遵守严格的欧洲隐私法），并经过 Securitum 的审核和验证。 与其他云存储服务相比，这是一个重大改进，其他云存储服务不仅可以访问您的数据，还可以通过有针对性的广告和数据共享从中获利。

如果您要进行转换，Internxt 提供跨平台兼容性，因此您可以通过桌面应用程序、网络浏览器应用程序以及 iOS 或 Android 应用程序轻松地将其集成到您的所有设备和操作系统上。
